name: science-campaign
description: Top-level science-agent campaign: deterministic preflight, then plan -> round -> close -> stop-rule gate until a stop rule fires, then a traceable wrap-up
whenToUse: Call when the user asks to run experiments, continue, improve the score, run overnight/until target, or run N rounds in a locked science-agent workspace (any domain pack). The campaign owns every round and its bookkeeping: mode choice, round begin/close, stop rules, and the campaign record all come from `sagent`. It never submits or reveals the holdout.

phases.title: Preflight
phases.detail: doctor, campaign begin, domain pack, stop-rule check

phases.title: Plan
phases.detail: round begin in the mode chosen by campaign check

phases.title: Round
phases.detail: science-round: scout, hypotheses, select, execute, verify

phases.title: Close
phases.detail: round close: decide, claims, report, outcome, stop rules
